<reason>CON won the affordability-for-value clash. PRO never solved the windfall critique that a citywide ban creates value everywhere but requires nothing, guaranteeing zero below-market homes, while bonuses tailor extraction to market strength. CON also turned PRO's often attack and answered infrastructure with plannable artery vs fragile capillaries, leaving PRO with filtering-trickle plus veto-removal against immediate teardown repricing.</reason>
